source.author: ov
source.text: Iussit et extendi campos, subsidere valles, fronde tegi silvas, lapidosos surgere montes.
source.text_original: Iussit et extendi campos, subsidere valles, / fronde tegi silvas, lapidosos surgere montes.
source.text_english: He ordered the plains to be extended, the valleys to sink down, the forests to be covered with foliage, and the rocky mountains to rise.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: Quanto igitur rectius omissis insensibilibus et uanis eo tendere ubi sedes, ubi ha.b itatio est dei ueri, qui terram stabili firmitate suspendit, qui caelum astris fulgentibus, qui solem rebus humanis clarissimum ac singulare lumen argumentum suae unicae maiestatis accendit, terris autem maria circumfudit, flumina sempiterno lapsu praecepit, iussit et extendi campos, subsidere ualtes , fronde tegi siluas, lapidosos surgere .
reuse.text_original: Quanto igitur rectius omissis insensibilibus et uanis eo tendere ubi sedes, ubi ha.b itatio est dei ueri, qui terram stabili firmitate suspendit, qui caelum astris fulgentibus, qui solem rebus humanis clarissimum ac singulare lumen argumentum suae unicae maiestatis accendit, terris autem maria circumfudit, flumina sempiterno lapsu praecepit, iussit et extendi campos, subsidere ualtes , fronde tegi siluas, lapidosos surgere .
reuse.text_english: How much more rightly, then, having put aside insensate and empty things, should one strive toward that place where there is the seat, where there is the dwelling of the true God, who suspended the earth with steadfast firmness, who lit the sky with shining stars, who made the sun blaze for human affairs as the most splendid and unique light, as a proof of his unique majesty, and who spread out the seas around the lands, commanded the rivers to flow in perpetual course, and ordered the plains to be stretched out, the valleys to sink down, the forests to be covered with foliage, the rocky places to rise up.
